name: Okapi multilingual instruction tuning benchmark
description: Benchmark datasets introduced to evaluate generative large language models instruction-tuned with reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) across 26 diverse languages, facilitating multilingual LLM research.
reputation: A specialized multilingual benchmark used in research on instruction-tuned and RLHF-aligned LLMs across many languages, but not a broadly standardized community leaderboard.
notes: First RLHF-based instruction tuning benchmark for multiple languages with datasets and evaluation resources released.
